chunks: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام was asked: What is the reason for shaving the head of the newborn?
He عليه السلام said: "It is to purify him from the hair of the womb."
ai.seo_question: Why is a newborn's head shaved in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the reason for shaving a newborn's head as purification from the hair associated with the womb. It reflects a reported practice connected to the rites surrounding a child's birth in Shia hadith literature.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4728 - Abu Abdullah (as) was asked about the reason for shaving the head of a newborn.
Imam (as) replied: "It is to purify the child from the hair of the womb."
